&nbsp;Job Position: Fleet Tracking Officer

Job Location: Sango Ota, Ogun

Job Summary


	The Fleet Tracking Officer is responsible for monitoring the real-time movement of trucks transporting company products from warehouses to customers and depots.
	The role ensures complete visibility of vehicles in transit, proactively identifies delays, route deviations, security risks, and operational issues, and coordinates timely interventions to ensure safe and on-time deliveries.


Key Responsibilities
Real-Time Monitoring:


	Monitor all trucks in transit using GPS tracking systems/fleet management platforms.
	Track truck locations, movement, speed, and estimated time of arrival (ETA).
	Monitor truck seals and delivery milestones where applicable.
	Ensure every dispatched truck remains visible until delivery is completed.


Transit Coordination:


	Maintain continuous communication with drivers and transport providers.
	Update warehouses, customer service, and sales teams on delivery progress.
	Escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, security threats, or unauthorized stops.
	Support route optimization and recovery plans where required.


Incident Management:


	Immediately report truck diversion, hijacking, theft, accidents, or prolonged delays.
	Maintain incident logs and follow up until issues are resolved.
	Coordinate with Security, Truck providers, Logistics operations team


Compliance:


	Ensure adherence to approved routes and journey management procedures.
	Monitor transporter compliance with company transportation standards.
	Coordinate pre-trip inspection for every truck before assigning shipment
	Ensure GIT insurance for all transporters are valid and value per carriage meets the minimum standard.
	Verify adherence to safety and security protocols.


Reporting:


	Produce daily truck movement and delivery status reports.
	Document route deviations, detention time, and delivery exceptions.
	Maintain accurate records of communications and transit activities.
	Daily pan-Nigeria depot operations report
	Daily Key Performance Indicator Report (KPI)


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Truck visibility rate.
	On-Time&amp; In-Full (OTIF).
	ETA accuracy.

	Delivery status update timeliness per sales area.
	Daily reporting accuracy.

Requirements

	Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of experience in logistics, fleet monitoring, or transportation operations.


Skills:


	Knowledge of GPS and fleet management systems.
	Excellent communication.
	Strong analytical(excel)and problem-solving skills.
	Attention to detail.
	Ability to multitask.

Fleet Tracking Officer Job at Grand Oak Limited




        
    

        
        Grand Oak Limited (GOL) - We are the largest Manufacturer of SpiritsandWines, we believe our spirits should have character; an authenticity derived from where they are distilled, bottled and the philosophies of those who distil them.

There are many attributes that describe us resolute, self-sufficient, tough, hard-working, enduring, emotional, passionate, philosophical and engaging.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Fleet Tracking Officer

Job Location: Sango Ota, Ogun

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Fleet Tracking Officer is responsible for monitoring the real-time movement of trucks transporting company products from warehouses to customers and depots.
	The role ensures complete visibility of vehicles in transit, proactively identifies delays, route deviations, security risks, and operational issues, and coordinates timely interventions to ensure safe and on-time deliveries.


Key Responsibilities
Real-Time Monitoring:


	Monitor all trucks in transit using GPS tracking systems/fleet management platforms.
	Track truck locations, movement, speed, and estimated time of arrival (ETA).
	Monitor truck seals and delivery milestones where applicable.
	Ensure every dispatched truck remains visible until delivery is completed.


Transit Coordination:


	Maintain continuous communication with drivers and transport providers.
	Update warehouses, customer service, and sales teams on delivery progress.
	Escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, security threats, or unauthorized stops.
	Support route optimization and recovery plans where required.


Incident Management:


	Immediately report truck diversion, hijacking, theft, accidents, or prolonged delays.
	Maintain incident logs and follow up until issues are resolved.
	Coordinate with Security, Truck providers, Logistics operations team


Compliance:


	Ensure adherence to approved routes and journey management procedures.
	Monitor transporter compliance with company transportation standards.
	Coordinate pre-trip inspection for every truck before assigning shipment
	Ensure GIT insurance for all transporters are valid and value per carriage meets the minimum standard.
	Verify adherence to safety and security protocols.


Reporting:


	Produce daily truck movement and delivery status reports.
	Document route deviations, detention time, and delivery exceptions.
	Maintain accurate records of communications and transit activities.
	Daily pan-Nigeria depot operations report
	Daily Key Performance Indicator Report (KPI)


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Truck visibility rate.
	On-Time& In-Full (OTIF).
	ETA accuracy.
	Incident response time.
	Route deviation resolution time.
	Delivery status update timeliness per sales area.
	Daily reporting accuracy.
	Rate of GIT compliance per / transporter.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.
	2–4 years of experience in logistics, fleet monitoring, or transportation operations.


Skills:


	Knowledge of GPS and fleet management systems.
	Excellent communication.
	Strong analytical(excel)and problem-solving skills.
	Attention to detail.
	Ability to multitask.

Digital Marketing / Social Media Executive Job at Saro Agrosciences




        
    

        
        Saro Agrosciences is the flagship company of Saroafrica International group and was established in 1991. Saro Agrosciences has grown into a leading player in the agriculture industry. We are passionately committed to empowering the Nigerian farmer with superior agro-inputs like crop protection products, seeds, fertilizers, and knowledge that will enable these farmers to increase their yield and livelihood in a sustainable manner

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Marketing / Social Media Executive

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	The Digital Marketing/Social Media Executive manages the company’s social media and other digital platforms to increase brand visibility, promote product adoption, and engage target audiences.
	The role involves working closely with external agencies to execute effective digital campaigns that will achieve the company's set goals.


Key Responsibilities
Social Media Management:


	Collaborate with a digital agency to develop and execute social media strategies aligned with SAS crops of focus and their respective growing seasons.
	Coordinate the creation, scheduling, and publishing of engaging, audience-specific content across Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and YouTube.
	Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and audience engagement to continuously optimize content performance.
	Build and nurture online communities by responding promptly to inquiries and feedback.
	Maintain a positive brand image and encourage active audience participation.


Performance Analysis & Reporting:


	Review and interpret performance reports provided by the digital agency.
	Translate social media performance data into clear insights and recommendations for improvement.
	Provide summarized performance updates to the Head of Marketing to support decision-making. Key Skills & Competencies
	Strong understanding of social media marketing, content strategy, and SEO.
	Proficiency with tools such as Google Analytics, Hootsuite, Buffer, Canva, or Adobe Suite.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to multitask, meet deadlines, and adapt to evolving priorities.
	Knowledge of agricultural trends and crop production is an advantage.


Qualification and Expertise


	Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline, with at least a Second Class Upper (2:1).
	3 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing or social media management.
	Age Requirement: 26 – 32 Years

HR Supervisor Job at Huko Advisory Services




        
    

        
        At Huko Advisory Services, we help businesses unlock their full potential through smart, strategic, and innovative human capital solutions. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, we provide HR outsourcing, recruitment, training, consulting, and workforce development services to businesses across industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Supervisor

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

Key Roles / Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Lead recruitment and selection processes
	Develop and implement HR policies.
	Oversee performance management and staff development.
	Ensure compliance with HR policies and regulations.
	Manage and supervise payroll administration.
	Coordinate employee training and development programs.
	Strong communication, coordination and maintain a positive organizational culture.


Qualifications and Experiences


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or any related fields;
	5 to 7 years of relevant experience in HR Management including leadership or strategic HR responsibilities.
	Professional HR certifications such as CIPM, SHRM, CIPD, PHR or equivalent are highly preferred.
	Proficiency in MS O?ice Suite and Google Workspace.
	Proven experience in Payroll Administration, including salary processing, statutory remittances and payroll compliance.
	Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
	Strong knowledge of employment legislation and HR best practices.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
	Applicants must be residing around Lekki/Ajah axis.


Remuneration


	Salary: N250,000 Monthly
	Other Benefits: HMO and Leave Allowance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Human Resources (HR) Officer Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resources (HR) Officer

Job Locations: Victoria Island and Ikoyi - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee documentation.
	Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
	Assist with payroll inputs, leave administration, and attendance management.
	Ensure compliance with company policies and labour regulations.
	Coordinate employee engagement and performance management activities.
	Handle HR correspondence and provide administrative support to the HR team.


Requirements


	Education: Bachelor's degree or HND in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 6 months' HR experience.
	Software Skills: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word).
	Core Competencies: Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
	Work Style: Ability to maintain confidentiality and work with minimal supervision.


Salary
N100,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "HR Officer - Victor" as the subject of the mail.
